test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution: The correct answer is: **reinforcing.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning **of the given words. • **Reinforcing**: Strengthening or supporting an object or substance, especially with additional material. (किसी वस्तु या पदार्थ को मजबूत करना या सहारा देना, विशेष रूप से अतिरिक्त सामग्री के साथ) • **Accentuate**: Make more noticeable or prominent. (अधिक ध्यान देने योग्य या प्रमुख बनाना) • **Augment**: To make something larger or fuller by adding something to it. (इसमें कुछ जोड़कर कुछ बड़ा या पूर्ण बनाना; बढ़ाना) • **Ebbing**: To decline or decay; fade away. (कम होना) • So, as per the meaning of the given words "**reinforcing**" is the most appropriate option. • The implied meaning of the sentence is: Social media and cyberbullying harm young people, **encouraging **their negative self-perceptions and pushing them into suicide. • Therefore, the correct answer is option 1. Complete passage: *Four of the most popular forms i.e. Facebook, Twitter, Snapchat, and Instagram of social media (1) inflict__ great damage to young people’s mental health. These four platforms have a negative effect because they can __(2) exacerbate__ children’s and young people’s body image worries, and worsen bullying, sleep problems, anxiety, depression, and loneliness. The findings follow growing __(3) concern__* *among politicians, health bodies, doctors, and parents about young people suffering harm as a result of cyberbullying and social media **(4) __reinforcing__*** *feelings of self-loathing and leading them to commit suicide. However, the leader of the UK’s psychiatrists said these findings were too simplistic and they (5)________ blamed social media for the complex reasons why the mental health of so many young people is suffering.* 1b3:T11b6, The correct answer is unfairly.
